task.description: Diagnose root cause of TC-EXP-401-02/03/04/05 failures in tests/integration/exp401_exp402_comp_restore_test.zig. Read the test file, the EXP-401 definition-creation path (src/definition/store.zig), and the canonical process graph validator (src/definition/graph.zig). Determine exactly why invalid graphs are accepted.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause identified with evidence (code reading + test run), not guessed

result.summary: Root cause found: src/definition/graph.zig defines validateCompensationHandlers() and validateReversibility(), both already returning the correct typed violations (COMPENSATION_HANDLER_SCOPE_UNKNOWN, COMPENSATION_HANDLER_NOT_REVERSED, NON_REVERSIBLE_ACTIVITY, ERROR_BOUNDARY_EVENTS_MISSING), but neither function is called anywhere. src/definition/store.zig's three graph-mutating paths (create/promote/update) only call validateGraph/validateNodeAttributes/validateEdgeConditions/validateEdgeTransforms before persistence. Confirmed by running zig build test-integration-exp401-exp402 (new narrow target added for this run) on the unmodified code: TC-EXP-401-02/03/04 failed as expected (definition created without error), TC-EXP-401-05 also failed for a second, related reason (parseErrorBoundaryConfig() rejected empty on_error_event/on_cancel_event as error.InvalidInput before validateCompensationHandlers()'s dedicated ERROR_BOUNDARY_EVENTS_MISSING check could run). A third investigation thread (whether tests/integration/exp401_exp402_comp_restore_test.zig was wired into build.zig) was pursued and initially misdiagnosed as a wiring gap; corrected after finding tests/integration/main_test.zig already @imports and pins the file per the ISS-0137/GH-439 pattern, so it was already reachable and executed under zig build test-integration.
